# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book was written in Quarto using the `cosmo` theme with
local overrides in `practicum.scss`. R code is executed by
`knitr` and rendered with `downlit` for function-level
hyperlinks.

Body text is set in Source Sans 3 (fallbacks Inter,
Helvetica Neue, Arial); headings and UI in the same face;
code in JetBrains Mono (fallbacks Fira Mono, Menlo). Syntax
highlighting uses the accessibility-tuned `arrow` palette,
consistent between HTML and PDF output.

PDF output is produced by `xelatex` with the `scrbook`
document class at 6.5 × 9 inches. The PDF monofont is
DejaVu Sans Mono for complete Unicode coverage of
box-drawing and mathematical glyphs.

The prose, figures, and exercises are licensed CC BY 4.0. Code
blocks printed in the text are MIT; the package code and build
scripts are GPL-3. Third-party images are excluded from both and
carry their own terms, recorded in [Credits](credits.qmd). The
full statement is in `LICENSE.md`.

Source available at <https://github.com/rgt47/practicum>.

## Build environment

The lockfile `renv.lock` at the root of the repository records
the package versions the book is meant to be built with. It
records intentions, not what happened. This edition was built
against the R library installed on the build machine, not a
library restored from the lockfile, and the repository contains
no Dockerfile for the book, so neither the operating system nor
the system libraries are pinned. That gap is what @sec-renv and
@sec-docker teach you to close.

The tables below record what was actually used. They are
generated by R when this page is executed, not typed, so they
cannot drift from the build they describe. Because the book is
rendered with Quarto's `freeze` option, they describe the last
render in which this page was executed.

```{r}
#| label: colophon-setup
#| echo: false
lock_path <- file.path('..', '..', 'renv.lock')
lock <- if (file.exists(lock_path) &&
  requireNamespace('jsonlite', quietly = TRUE)) {
  jsonlite::read_json(lock_path)
} else {
  NULL
}

run_quarto_version <- function() {
  bin_dir <- Sys.getenv('QUARTO_BIN_PATH')
  bin <- if (nzchar(bin_dir)) {
    file.path(bin_dir, 'quarto')
  } else {
    unname(Sys.which('quarto'))
  }
  if (!nzchar(bin)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  out <- tryCatch(
    suppressWarnings(
      system2(bin, '--version', stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE)
    ),
    error = \(e) character(0)
  )
  if (length(out) == 0) NA_character_ else out[[1]]
}

quarto_version <- function() {
  from_env <- Sys.getenv('QUARTO_VERSION')
  if (nzchar(from_env)) {
    return(from_env)
  }
  if (requireNamespace('quarto', quietly = TRUE)) {
    v <- tryCatch(as.character(quarto::quarto_version()),
      error = \(e) NA_character_)
    if (!is.na(v)) {
      return(v)
    }
  }
  v <- run_quarto_version()
  if (is.na(v)) 'not detected' else v
}

na_as <- function(x, value) ifelse(is.na(x), value, x)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-colophon-system
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: 'The system that built this edition, recorded at render
#|   time.'
system_info <- data.frame(
  Component = c('R', 'R (lockfile)', 'Platform', 'Operating system',
    'Quarto', 'Rendered'),
  Version = c(
    paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = '.'),
    na_as(lock$R$Version %||% NA_character_, 'no lockfile found'),
    R.version$platform,
    na_as(utils::osVersion %||% NA_character_, 'unknown'),
    quarto_version(),
    format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z')
  )
)
knitr::kable(system_info)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-colophon-packages
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: 'Versions of the packages the book attaches most, as used
#|   for this build and as recorded in the lockfile.'
book_packages <- c('knitr', 'rmarkdown', 'dplyr', 'tidyr', 'readr',
  'ggplot2', 'purrr', 'patchwork', 'gtsummary', 'naniar', 'mice',
  'survival', 'palmerpenguins', 'tinytest', 'renv')

used_version <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  utils::packageDescription(pkg)$Version
}

locked_version <- function(pkg) {
  lock$Packages[[pkg]]$Version %||% NA_character_
}

used <- purrr::map_chr(book_packages, used_version)
locked <- purrr::map_chr(book_packages, locked_version)

package_versions <- data.frame(
  Package = book_packages,
  Used = na_as(used, 'not installed'),
  Lockfile = na_as(locked, 'not recorded'),
  Match = ifelse(!is.na(used) & !is.na(locked) & used == locked,
    'yes', 'no')
)
stopifnot(nrow(package_versions) == length(book_packages))
knitr::kable(package_versions)
```

A 'no' in the last column of @tbl-colophon-packages is a finding,
not a typo. Either this edition was built with a version other
than the one the lockfile records, or the lockfile does not record
the package at all. In both cases a reader who restores the
lockfile will not get the environment that produced this book,
which is the silent failure habit 4 exists to make loud.
